57th GST Council: 7 decisions that change how you run your business 👇

The Council met on 8 October 2026. Here's what matters for a business owner, in plain words:

1️⃣ Late fee relief: turnover up to ₹5 crore, return filed within the same month → no late fee (interest still applies)
2️⃣ No show cause notice if the tax involved is below ₹10,000
3️⃣ One GST return a year for small B2C businesses (approved in principle)
4️⃣ No arrest; prosecution only above ₹5 crore (earlier ₹1 crore)
5️⃣ Faster refunds: 90% sanctioned automatically for exporters and inverted duty
6️⃣ From April 2027 returns: GSTR-3B must match GSTR-1 and GSTR-2B
7️⃣ More ITC (employee health and life insurance) and easier registration

⚠️ These are recommendations. Keep filing exactly as you do now until the Government notifies them.

Your auditor uploads Form 3CA or 3CB with 3CD, and you must accept it on the income-tax portal. Until you accept it, the report is not treated as filed.

Missing the date can attract a penalty of 0.5% of turnover, up to ₹1.5 lakh (section 271B), unless there is a reasonable cause.

GST officers took ₹47,45,000 in cash from his home in November 2022. Nearly four years later, the High Court ordered it returned, with interest.

Why? Section 67(2) of the CGST Act lets officers seize goods, documents, books and things. Money is not "goods" under section 2(52). The tax dispute on his stock continues separately in appeal.

If officers visit: get the cash listed separately in the panchnama with whose it is, keep proof of where it came from, and ask for its release in writing.

Case: Bhagwan Tirthani v. Principal Commissioner, CGST Jaipur, Rajasthan High Court (2026). The Bombay and Delhi High Courts have taken the same view.

Buying Diwali gifts for your team and clients? Check these three numbers first.

₹15,000: what an employee can get in gifts and vouchers tax-free in a year (it was ₹5,000 till March 2026). Cross it and the whole amount is taxed as salary.

₹50,000: gifts to an employee up to this value in a year stay outside GST. Input tax credit on gifts is still blocked.

₹20,000: gifts to one client or dealer above this in a year need 10% TDS before you hand them over.

Cash, gift cheques and the Diwali bonus are taxed as salary, whatever the amount.

GST froze a business's bank account with one line of reasoning. The Bombay High Court quashed it. 🏦

The case (S.K. Enterprises v. Union of India, reported 10 Oct 2026):
• 5 May 2026: GST attached the firm's bank account and every account linked to its PAN (Form DRC-22, Section 83)
• Only reason given: "to protect the interests of Revenue"
• High Court: an attachment needs real material and reasons in the order itself. Explaining later in an affidavit doesn't fix it.
